title: Validation of the theoretical domains framework for use in behaviour change and implementation research
notes: Experts sorted 112 constructs; fuzzy cluster analysis supported 14 higher-order domains. Used as a crosswalk, not a pooling mandate.

title: Determinants of behaviour and their efficacy as targets of behavioural change interventions
notes: Multidisciplinary review of meta-analyses that ranks individual and social-structural intervention targets; establishes important prior art for MetaRank.
